doc.title: Labeler Setup and Label Roll Change
doc.file: WI-212 Labeler Setup and Label Roll Change.pdf
doc.purpose: Apply labels straight, wrinkle-free and in the right place, and change rolls without a line stop.

roles.name: Operator
roles.does: Sets up the labeler and changes rolls.

roles.name: Line Lead
roles.does: Decides whether to stop the line for repeated jams.

roles.name: QA Technician
roles.does: Is called if jams continue on a second lot.

references.as_written: QP-308 Incoming Inspection of Packaging Materials
QP-309 Packaging Material Specifications and Approved Suppliers

parameters.quote: Set web tension to mark 4 on the dancer arm.

parameters.what: jams or web breaks per hour that trigger a roll hold
parameters.quote: Three jams or web breaks in one hour: tell the Line Lead.

rules.topic: which suppliers' packaging may be used
rules.statement: Rolls from a supplier not listed in QP-309 are not to be loaded.
rules.quote: Rolls from a supplier not listed in QP-309 are not to be loaded.

rules.statement: Operators load only label rolls with a green QA release sticker.
rules.quote: Use only label rolls with a green QA release sticker (see QP-308).

rules.statement: The Operator puts a roll aside with a hold tag after three jams in an hour.
rules.quote: Put the roll aside with a hold tag as described in QP-315 and load a roll from a different lot.
